# Arcane

Arcane is a lightweight, mobile-friendly dark theme whose recorded description traces it to Dracula and LYT and centres it on a cyan accent, with syntax highlighting kept readable. It follows a base16 framework, so changing its eight base colour variables remakes the whole look at once.

![Arcane screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xryul/obsidian-arcane-theme/HEAD/Arcane_sample_01.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Arcane"
    author: "xryul"
    repo:   "xryul/obsidian-arcane-theme"
    slug:   "arcane"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/arcane"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/xryul/obsidian-arcane-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xryul/obsidian-arcane-theme/HEAD/Arcane_sample_01.jpg"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a lightweight, mobile-friendly dark theme inspired by Dracula and LYT that uses a calm cyan-accented palette for clear, readable syntax highlighting. Change eight base color variables to remake the look instantly using a base16 framework."
}
```
